description: 避難所・救護施設一覧 [evacuation shelters and public facilities and fire, police and emergency services] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 阿波市. 阿波市の避難所。 救護施設の一覧です. Coverage: 阿波市. The portal files it under the publisher 阿波市. Its tags are 災害, 防災. It offers 1 resource(s) in xlsx. The portal shows 2022-05-31 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
